criteria.closure: Legacy executable operations and actual scalar SSA/PHIs convert to the same independently checked primitive program; v2 elaboration re-enters verify_core; canonical exports survive source-free reload.
limits: Legacy compatibility commands remain separate paths with their original scopes.
No whole-compiler refinement or Rust-wide soundness theorem.
criteria.name: 统一两条实现线

criteria.closure: Standalone JSON programs, immutable bytes, independent verification, interpreter and direct LLVM admit no producer hash as authority; invalid control flow/resource use and binding tampering reject.
limits: Typed resource-aware assembly/IR, not arbitrary machine assembly or raw foreign pointers.
Native public boundary is scalar C ABI; supported direct targets remain explicit.
Verification checks safety rules, not user intent or arbitrary behavioral equivalence.
criteria.name: 建立独立 HIA 入口

criteria.closure: Finite generic products/enums, local stored owner/parent/child loan identity, error paths and explicit cooperative task cancellation compose and execute through one primitive core.
limits: Stored loans cannot escape functions; enum payloads and task states/results cannot carry loans.
Task linear ownership is statically checked; some phase transitions are runtime guards, including double start and premature join.
No recursive heap ADTs, background scheduler, preemption, channels or general concurrency.
No cleanup guarantee after native abort or interpreter execution-budget exhaustion.
criteria.name: 完成可组合资源核心

criteria.closure: Actual captured compile_commands, Clang concrete templates/overloads and source implementations lower to standalone HIA with complete declaration dispositions for the captured finite profile; native behavior, scalar ABI and original-code exclusion observed separately.
limits: 70 rows include containers, parameters, prototypes and repeated-header declarations, not 70 independent APIs.
Owned C++ migration still recognizes a complete normalized ownership protocol; it does not translate arbitrary custom RAII.
No general class/STL templates, pointers/references, exceptions, vtables, C++ mangled/class/aggregate ABI preservation.
Finite defined-source oracle cases are not an all-input translation theorem.
Translation time/artifact sizes measured; human review, maintenance and total migration cost unmeasured.
criteria.name: 扩大完整 C/C++ 迁移

criteria.closure: Frozen run1 records all 63 samples passing its v1 quality/performance gates against both checked Rust baselines; x86-64 native and AArch64 QEMU composed execution are retained.
limits: Performance-only revision 6899d4761c3a42437ac02b7b5c6c8f8aa153dd79 changes fixed build layout and exact retention; fresh v2 timed acceptance is not included in this audit.
Static layout probes have zero timing samples and cannot substitute for v2 measurement.
Rust allocator traces are not compared; HIA allocation effects and standard Rust optimizer scopes differ explicitly.
QEMU is not physical boards, device timing, DMA/MMIO, GPU or arbitrary allocator qualification.
Legacy Cortex-M4 gate does not establish standalone 32-bit HIA or device-protocol correctness.
No Rust-wide performance superiority established.
criteria.name: 建立性能与硬件资格

criteria.closure: Owned Qwen GGUF process produced 29 validated generations: 2 preflight probes and 27 comparative attempts; all 16 native controls actually executed. Frozen four-task 2x2 outcomes and token/time observations retained.
limits: HIA full 1/4; HIA patch 2/4; Rust full 2/4; Rust expression 0/4 are descriptive pilot outcomes.
One quantized model and four disclosed single-site repair tasks do not establish independent general coding advantage.
Maintenance, human labor and total development-cost improvement not measured.
criteria.name: 证明 agent 收益

method: Read-only implementation and retained-evidence review; SHA-256 readback of listed artifacts; no benchmark, model inference, interpreter or native program rerun.
open_acceptance_dependencies: General compositional resource features outside the declared profile.
Historical C/C++ ecosystem coverage, complex ABI and measured total migration cost.
Fresh fixed-layout v2 performance evidence and physical hardware/device qualification.
Independent improvement in agent success/error/maintenance and total development cost.
review_independence: Separate acceptance review within the implementation team; reviewer authored the finite C++ template and composite qualifiers. Not third-party certification.
source_scope: Pinned implementation at source_commit; later performance-only revision is separately disclosed.
trusted_external_conditions: Verifier/elaborator/interpreter and LLVM emission implementation correctness; no whole-compiler refinement theorem supplied.
Native Clang/LLVM/linker/loader, selected platform ABI, libc allocator contracts, ordinary stack and host hardware.
Captured C/C++ build and dependency/configuration inventory; behavior comparisons exclude undefined source executions.
Exact reviewed QEMU arena/calloc runtime for AArch64 composed results; physical hardware and device protocols require separate evidence.
Agent inference provenance is owned local process and file identity, not remote or hardware attestation.
